mp4-muxer 5.2.1 by Vanilagy, MIT licence (see LICENSE).
https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer
Unmodified copy of build/mp4-muxer.mjs from the npm package, renamed .js so every
server gives it a JavaScript content type (it is an ES module). Used by
story-cutter.html to write standard (non-fragmented) MP4 files.
